For vulnerabilities, use [private reporting](https://github.com/cosgroveb/ruby-osc7501-demo/security/advisories/new).

## What happened?

Describe the actual behavior and what you expected.

## Reproduce it

Include the command you ran and relevant output as text.
Remove secrets and unrelated private data.
